spans.text: Method: The authors used Granger causality methods to evaluate task‐based directional connectivity between medial or lateral prefrontal cortex (PFC) and amygdala in 20 unmedicated patients with current major depressive disorder (MDD) and 19 healthy matched controls while participants engaged in an affective variant of the flanker task comparing response to sad and neutral faces.

description.value: Participants completed a gender identification variant of the Eriksen flanker task of selective attention using selected Ekman faces as stimuli. The task included positive, sad, and neutral valence and nonconflict, congruent, and incongruent difficulty levels; only the nonconflict level is presented here.
